name: Gamma
summary: AI platform that turns prompts into presentations, documents, websites and social media visuals.
description: Gamma is an AI-powered platform for creating presentations, documents, websites and social media visuals from a prompt. The agent starts with a conversation, outlines a draft, then lets you refine with chat, smart layouts or freeform editing; PowerPoint and PDF imports keep formatting intact, 25+ connectors pull content from Slack, Notion and Dropbox, and decks export to PowerPoint, PDF, PNG and Google Slides. Custom branding, analytics and API access come with paid plans.
